name: ATM Security Configuration 3
definition: Configuration of the encryption or digital envelope, if the security module is able to perform encryption.

AsymmetricEncryption.name: Asymmetric Encryption
AsymmetricEncryption.definition: True if the security module is able to perform encryption with an asymmetric key.

AsymmetricKeyStandardIdentification.name: Asymmetric Key Standard Identification
AsymmetricKeyStandardIdentification.definition: True if the security module is able to identify an asymmetric key with certificate issuer X.500 name and certificate serial number. False if a proprietary asymmetric key identifier is required.

AsymmetricEncryptionAlgorithm.name: Asymmetric Encryption Algorithm
AsymmetricEncryptionAlgorithm.definition: Asymmetric encryption algorithm the security module is able to manage.

SymmetricTransportKey.name: Symmetric Transport Key
SymmetricTransportKey.definition: True if the security module is able to manage a symmetric transport session key to protect cryptographic keys and data. False if only a previously exchanged symmetric key must be used; a proprietary symmetric key identifier is then used.

SymmetricTransportKeyAlgorithm.name: Symmetric Transport Key Algorithm
SymmetricTransportKeyAlgorithm.definition: Symmetric transport session key algorithm the security module is able to manage.

SymmetricEncryptionAlgorithm.name: Symmetric Encryption Algorithm
SymmetricEncryptionAlgorithm.definition: Symmetric encryption algorithm the security module is able to manage.

EncryptionFormat.name: Encryption Format
EncryptionFormat.definition: Format of data before encryption, if the format is not plaintext or implicit.
